description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Cheque' class for an OpenCart payment extension. It manages the display and configuration of the cheque payment method in the admin panel.

classes.name: Cheque
classes.description: The Cheque class handles the admin interface for configuring cheque payment method, including displaying the form and processing the save action.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for the cheque payment extension in the admin panel.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the cheque payment method via AJAX.
